cases.title: The current layer stays BLOCKS after every way of ending PIT and CD (New Pit Cancel, Esc at CD's third point, New Pipe Cancel, a placed pit ended with Esc, a placed pipe ended with Esc), and nothing new lands on layer 0 or BLOCKS
cases.plan_item: UX-LYR-01 office layers, the current layer after each Esc path (daily card D24 assertion 1; the card stays part: 'never recolour a layer' is not built)
cases.expected: CLAYER reads BLOCKS at the start and after each of the five endings: PIT then New Pit 'Cancel without saving'; CD from 150000,-85000 to 170000,-85000 then Esc at the third point ('[CE] CD command cancelled.', nothing drawn); the same CD with Enter then New Pipe 'Cancel without saving'; PIT at 150000,-80000 with Continue placement then three Esc; CD from 150000,-80000 to 170000,-80000 with Start Pipe then one Esc. Nothing new is on layer 0 or on BLOCKS; exactly one new pit and one new pipe exist.
cases.why_not_unit: Layer choice and the current-layer restore happen in the live drawing's layer table on each real cancel path.
not_automated: 'An existing layer is never recoloured' is not built (card D24 correction 3); the layer table is not read.
The current layer is read after each path has ended, not while CE waits at a prompt (AutoCAD is busy then).
